SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
WEDNESDAY - APRIL 17, 2019 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
APRIL 17, 2019, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Dr. William “Bill” Hundley, II, Pastor, House of Worship
  International and L.A. County Sheriff Chaplain.

  Mayor Pulido presented a proclamation to Pastor Dr. William “Bill” Hundley, II in
  recognition of his service to the City and the community.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was given by Cub Scout Pack 529.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Naresh Solanki
  Mayor/Chair Mark E. Pulido

5.  Public Comments

  None.

6.  Installation/Reorganization of the City Council and Successor Agency

  Mayor/Chair Pulido introduced the dignitaries in attendance. Council/Agency
  Members Edwards, Yokoyama, Hu, Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Solanki, and
  Mayor/Chair Pulido introduced family and guests in attendance.

  Mayor/Chair Pulido reflected upon his Mayoral term, noted the many achievements,
  and expressed his thanks to friends, staff, colleagues and family supporters.

  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary, declared the office of Mayor/Chair vacant
  and called for nominations for the office of Mayor/Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Edwards nominated Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Solanki for the
  Office of Mayor/Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, the City Clerk declared nominations closed.

  As nominated by Council/Agency Member Edwards, Council/Agency Member Solanki,
  was confirmed by a vote of (5 – 0) to the office of Mayor/Chair by acclamation.
 City of Cerritos  April 17, 2019
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 3

6.  Installation/Reorganization of the City Council and Successor Agency
  (continued).

  Mayor/Chair Solanki assumed the Mayor/Chair seat at the dais.

  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary, declared the Office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice
  Chair vacant and called for nominations for the Office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Mayor/Chair Solanki nominated Council/Agency Member Edwards for the office of Mayor
  Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Pulido nominated Council/Agency Member Yokoyama for the
  office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary,
  declared the nominations closed.

  As nominated by Mayor/Chair Solanki, Council/Agency Member Edwards was presented
  for consideration as Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair. A roll call vote was taken as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Solanki
  NOES:  Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  As nominated by Council/Agency Member Pulido, Council/Agency Member Yokoyama
  was presented for consideration as Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair. A roll call vote was taken
  as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama
  NOES:  Edwards, Solanki
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  As nominated by Council/Agency Member Pulido, Council/Agency Member Yokoyama,
  was confirmed by a vote of (3 - 2) to the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair by
  acclamation.

  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Yokoyama assumed the Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair seat at the
  dais.

  Comments were made by newly designated Mayor/Chair Solanki.

  A video presentation was displayed highlighting the accomplishments and
  activities of immediate past Mayor/Chair Pulido’s mayoral year (2018-2019).

  Various dignitaries and representatives from local and regional agencies and
  organizations made presentations to immediate past Mayor/Chair Pulido.

  Brief comments were provided by Council/Agency Members Edwards, Hu, and
  Pulido, Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Yokoyama, and Mayor/Chair Solanki.

6.  Installation/Reorganization of the City Council and Successor Agency
  (continued).

  Mayor/Chair Solanki invited those in attendance to a reception at the Cerritos Center
  for the Performing Arts.

7.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:35 p.m.
